field_principles.code_predictor_minus_vote_ci95: Task-level bootstrap CI95 of the 2nd-corpus delta -- excluding 0 confirms the win is not corpus-specific noise.
field_principles.code_predictor_minus_vote_delta: predictor@1 - vote@1 on the 2nd corpus -- compare to .392's +0.03125.
field_principles.code_replication_beats_vote: BARE bool: predictor@1 - vote@1 CI95-excl-0 AND headroom on the SECOND corpus -- robustness of the oracle-distinct code win; NOT the circular execution result.
field_principles.code_replication_retired: BARE bool: true iff a fresh distinct pool cannot be built in-window -> the .392 single-corpus +3.1pp stands (no 3rd block).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A replication win, a corpus-specific tie, a no-headroom, AND a retire are ALL COMPLETE -- each calibrates the robustness of the .392 code win.
field_principles.model_specs: The gen model (SOTA GGUF) + pass-predictor + oracle-distinct feature set + calibrated loss; required methodology.
field_principles.oracle_at_k: 2nd-corpus positive-control ceiling (any candidate passes) -- if ~=vote the null is uninformative.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; gen + fold split seeded.
field_principles.replication_read: replicates / corpus_specific / no_headroom -- the robustness read anchoring the .394 headline alongside the ARC result.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the 2nd code pool + fold split; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- the predictor scores code WITHOUT executing tests at inference (label is the training target only).

methodology_note: Hidden-test pass labels are supervised targets only. Candidate scoring uses code text, AST/lexical statistics, normalized-code agreement, and self-consistency margins without executing candidate tests at inference.

model_specs.feature_set: code text hash embeddings, lexical/AST statistics, normalized code signature duplicate agreement, and cross-candidate self-consistency margins
model_specs.retry_policy: use cached distinct hidden-label pool first; if absent, require SOTA GGUF cache before any generation; retire rather than fabricate if no fresh pool can be built in-window
model_specs.source_distinctness_gate: source file sha256 must not overlap exp4233 source corpus
